algorithm.name: recursive-binary-mirror-alpha-canonical-v1
algorithm.description: For each equation, recursively replace every binary product (left ◇ right) with (dual(right) ◇ dual(left)); retain equality orientation; alpha-normalize variables by first occurrence across left then right; map the canonical signature to the unique 1-indexed Equation ID in the authoritative order-5 enumeration.

generator.parser: self-contained parser in generator; no order-5 dual implementation imported
